blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Unsupervised 4D medical image interpolation reconstructs intermediate anatomical states from temporally sparse observations without intermediate supervision. Distinct motion fields may attain comparable endpoint agreement while producing different intermediate anatomy, giving rise to motion ambiguity. This ambiguity is difficult to constrain when many independently adjustable motion variables must be estimated from the observed endpoints. We develop a framework that learns a motion manifold to restrict candidate motion fields while retaining sample-specific variation. Cross-Sample Spectral Basis Learning extracts recurring motion structure from endpoint-derived dense estimates and encodes it in a shared spectral basis. Sample-Conditioned Cayley Basis Reorientation uses predicted motion coordinates to rotate the effective motion directions for each endpoint pair without increasing the number of independent coordinates. Their composition defines a nonlinear family of complete velocity fields across endpoint pairs, accommodating anatomical and motion-state differences within a restricted representation. Integrating each predicted field supports bidirectional reconstruction at arbitrary intermediate times. Theoretical analysis establishes sufficient conditions under which endpoint observations distinguish nearby motions within the learned family. Experiments on ACDC and 4D-Lung demonstrate state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated methods trained without intermediate volumes and competitive results against methods using intermediate supervision.
blocks.zh: 未受监督的4D医学影像内插从时空稀疏的观测中重建出中间解剖状态而无需中间监督. 不同的运动场可能在产生不同的中间解剖时达成类似的终点协议,从而引起运动模糊. 当许多可独立调整的运动变量必须从观测到的终点来估计时,这种模糊性就难以限制. 我们开发一个框架,学习运动多面性,限制候选运动场,同时保留特定样本的变化。 跨分光谱基础学习从端点产生的密集估计中提取出反复运动结构,并用共享光谱基础编码. 有条件的样本 Cayley Base 重新定向使用预测的运动坐标来旋转每个端点对的有效运动方向而不会增加独立坐标的数量. 他们的构成定义了一个由横跨端点对的完整速度场组成的非线性家族,在受限制的代表权范围内容纳解剖和运动状态的差异. 将每个预测的字段整合在一起,支持任意中间时间的双向重建. 理论分析确立了充分的条件,在这种条件下,端点观测可以区分所学家庭内附近的动议. 有关非洲催化分解中心和4D-Lung的实验显示,经过培训的经评价方法的性能最先进,没有中间卷,也没有利用中间监督方法取得竞争结果。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: 4D medical imaging captures anatomical change over time and supports functional assessment [ 1 ] and image-guided intervention [ 2 ] . Volumetric acquisitions, including dynamic CT and MRI, face trade-offs between temporal resolution, spatial fidelity, and modality-dependent constraints such as acquisition time and radiation exposure [ 3 , 4 ] . Interpolating missing volumes offers a computational route to temporally denser anatomical observations without requiring equally dense acquisition [ 5 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 4D 医学成像捕捉随时间推移的解剖变化,并支持功能评估[1]和图像引导干预[2]. 量子获取,包括动态CT和核磁共振,在时间分辨率、空间忠诚度和依赖方式的限制,如获取时间和辐射照射之间面临权衡[3、4]。 将缺失的卷子内插,为时间密集的解剖观测提供了一个计算途径,而不需要同样密集的获取[5,6].

blocks.en: Unsupervised interpolation learns without intermediate-volume targets, deriving supervision from the observed endpoints [ 6 ] . Endpoint reconstruction evaluates anatomical alignment but does not specify the intervening motion. As shown in Fig. 1 , distinct motion fields may attain comparable endpoint agreement while producing different intermediate anatomy, giving rise to motion ambiguity [ 7 , 8 ] . Learned correspondence [ 9 , 10 ] , temporal consistency [ 6 ] , and generative priors [ 11 , 12 ] guide estimation, yet endpoint fitting can retain many spatially distributed motion variables with only indirect evidence of how their changes should be coordinated.
blocks.zh: 无监督的内插学没有中间量目标,从观察到的终点获得监督 [6]. 端点重建评价解剖配合,但没有指定介入运动. 如图1所示,不同的运动场可能在产生不同的中间解剖时达成类似的端点协议,从而引起运动模糊性[7,8]. 获得的函证[9,10],时间一致性[6],和基因前传[11,12] 指导性估计,但端点匹配可以保留许多空间分布的运动变量,仅间接证明如何协调其变化.

blocks.en: Learning a motion manifold offers a representation-level route to constrain this ambiguity. It limits estimation to a family of complete motion fields described by a small set of motion coordinates [ 13 ] . These coordinates couple changes across the volume, allowing endpoint fitting to draw on recurring relationships between spatially separated regions. Statistical and learned models capture recurring anatomical motion [ 14 , 15 ] , alongside variation across individuals [ 16 ] and respiratory states [ 17 ] . A useful motion family should make this shared structure available as a constraint while accommodating the anatomy and motion state of each endpoint pair.
blocks.zh: 学习运动多面体为限制这种模糊性提供了一种代表性途径。 它将估计限制在一个由一小组运动坐标[13]描述的完整运动场组成的家族. 这些协调了整个体积的几处变化,使端点适合利用空间分离区域之间反复出现的关系。 统计模型和学习模型记录了反复出现的解剖运动[14、15],以及个人[16]和呼吸状态的变异[17]。 一个有用的运动家族应该使这种共享结构成为一种制约,同时适应每个端点对的解剖和运动状态.

blocks.en: Two challenges arise in learning this family from endpoint observations. 1) Shared motion structure must be inferred without intermediate motion targets. Endpoint-derived dense estimates provide motion evidence, but each is only one possible explanation of an endpoint pair. Their recurring variation must be identified across samples to establish a shared reference. 2) Sample-specific motion must remain expressive within the learned family. The restriction should accommodate changes in anatomy and motion state without restoring a large number of independently adjustable motion variables.
blocks.zh: 在从终点观察中了解这一家庭方面出现了两个挑战。 (1) 共享运动结构必须推定,而不设定中间运动目标。 端点产生的密集估计能提供运动证据,但每种都只是对端点对的一种可能的解释. 必须在样本中查明其反复出现的变化,以便建立共同的参考。 2) 特定样本运动必须保持被学家的表达力. 该限制应当适应解剖学和运动状态的变化,而不恢复大量可独立调整的运动变量.

blocks.en: We develop a framework that learns a motion manifold from endpoint observations and uses it to construct continuous deformations for interpolation. Cross-Sample Spectral Basis Learning summarizes endpoint-derived dense estimates in a shared spectral basis, providing a data-derived reference for motion synthesis. Sample-Conditioned Cayley Basis Reorientation uses motion coordinates predicted from each endpoint pair to rotate the effective directions within this representation. This coordinate-dependent reorientation supports nonlinear motion variation while keeping the number of independent coordinates fixed. The learned family constrains ambiguity by restricting the motion fields considered in endpoint fitting. Integrating the resulting velocity field supports bidirectional reconstruction at arbitrary query times. Theoretical analysis characterizes conditions under which endpoint observations distinguish nearby motion coordinates.
blocks.zh: 我们开发了一个框架,从端点观测中学习运动的多重性,并利用它来构建连续的变形以进行插值. 跨样本光谱基础学习在共享光谱的基础上总结了端点产生的密集估计,为运动合成提供了数据衍生的参考. 有条件的样本 Cayley Base Reform 使用从每个端点对中预测的运动坐标来在此表示中旋转有效方向. 这种依赖坐标的调整支持非线性运动变化,同时保持独立坐标数固定. 学习的家族通过限制最终点匹配时考虑的运动场来限制模糊性. 整合由此产生的速度字段支持任意查询时间的双向重建. 理论分析定性了端点观测区分附近运动坐标的条件.

blocks.en: The contributions of this work are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 这项工作的贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A 4D Medical Image Interpolation
blocks.zh: II-A 4D 医疗图像内插

blocks.en: Research on 4D medical image interpolation has developed motion representations and synthesis models for recovering unobserved anatomical changes [ 5 , 6 ] . More broadly, joint motion estimation and image reconstruction exploit the dependence of recovered detail on correspondence quality [ 18 , 19 ] . Among image interpolation methods, motion-guided approaches such as SVIN and MPVF use multi-scale representations to accommodate different motion magnitudes [ 5 , 20 ] . AMT strengthens matching through all-pairs correspondence and multiple motion fields [ 21 ] , while VFIFME reduces reconstruction’s dependence on imperfect motion estimates [ 22 ] . Generative modeling supplies temporal priors through deformation-aware diffusion in DDM [ 11 ] , latent dynamics in LDDM [ 23 ] , and Fourier guidance in FB-Diff [ 12 ] . These priors complement correspondence-based synthesis by drawing on recurring patterns of anatomical appearance and change.
blocks.zh: 对4D医学影像插图的研究已经开发出运动表达和合成模型,用于恢复未观测到的解剖变化[5,6]. 更广泛地说,联合运动估计和图像重建利用了回收细节对对应质量的依赖性[18,19]. 在图像内插法中,SVIN和MPVF等运动导引法使用多尺度表示法来容纳不同的运动星等[5,20]. VFIFME则减少重建对不完美运动估计的依赖[22]。 遗传模型通过DDM[11]的变形-知觉传播、LDDM[23]的潜伏动力学和FB-DIff[12]的Fourier导引提供时间前兆。 这些前科通过利用反复出现的解剖外观和变化规律来补充基于函证的合成.

blocks.en: The supervision used to learn motion varies across approaches. TMSDF transfers intermediate motion cues into time-modulated deformation fusion [ 24 ] . For unsupervised interpolation without intermediate training targets, UVI-Net uses cyclic endpoint reconstruction [ 6 ] , while TTT4MII uses instance-specific self-supervision [ 25 ] . Temporal parameterization and spatial consistency also influence the recovered anatomical sequence [ 26 , 27 ] . These designs strengthen reconstruction and temporal modeling, although endpoint agreement alone does not determine the intervening anatomical motion.
blocks.zh: 学习运动的监管方法各不相同。 TMSDF将中间运动提示转移到时间调制的变形聚变[24]. 对于没有中间训练目标的无监督的插值,UVI-Net使用循环端点重建[6],而TT4MII则使用实例特异性的自我监督[25]. 时间参数化和空间一致性也影响恢复的解剖序列[26,27]. 这些设计加强了重建和时间建模,虽然仅靠最终点协议不能决定介入解剖运动.

blocks.en: II-B Motion Ambiguity in Deformation Modeling
blocks.zh: II-B 变形模型中的模糊性

blocks.en: Motion ambiguity arises when different motion fields explain the same observed anatomy [ 28 ] . Spatial regularization in VM and TM [ 9 , 10 ] and velocity integration [ 29 , 30 ] guide deformation through local coherence and transformation structure. Shape-aware tracking uses anatomical boundaries to constrain correspondence [ 31 ] ; physical formulations incorporate tissue mechanics [ 32 ] or signal consistency [ 33 ] to supplement image agreement. Fourier-Net+ [ 34 ] and LRVF [ 35 ] restrict motion variation through band-limited and low-rank representations, with coefficient-based respiratory models providing related constraints [ 2 , 36 ] . Spatial penalties couple neighboring displacements, while compact coefficients link distant regions through shared directions. These restrictions narrow the search but do not specify every unobserved anatomical state. Recent work examines non-unique motion [ 7 ] , including velocity ambiguity in VD [ 8 ] . Probabilistic motion formulations model deformation distributions under partial observations [ 37 , 38 ] .
blocks.zh: 当不同的运动场解释同一观测到的解剖学[28]时,运动会产生模糊性. VM和TM[9,10]的空间规范化和速度融合[29,30]通过局部一致性和转型结构引导变形. 形状感知跟踪使用解剖边界来约束通信[31];物理配体包含组织力学[32]或信号一致性[33]来补充图像协议. Fourier-Net+[34]和LRVF[35]通过带限和低排名的表示限制运动变化,基于系数的呼吸模型提供相关的制约[2,36]. 邻近流离失所的夫妇受到空间惩罚,而紧凑的系数通过共同方向将遥远的地区联系在一起。 这些限制缩小了搜索范围,但没有具体说明每一个未观测到的解剖状态. 最近的工作审查了非独特运动[7],包括VD[8]中的速度模糊. 概率运动配体在部分观测下模型变形分布[37,38].

blocks.en: A learned motion manifold restricts candidate fields through coordinates describing their coordinated variation [ 13 ] . Statistical respiratory models [ 14 ] and learned deformation representations [ 39 , 40 ] extract recurring structure; manifold regularization guides estimated fields toward a learned family [ 41 ] . Related cardiac representations encode shape and temporal variation [ 42 , 43 , 44 ] , with conditional neural fields relating geometry to individual characteristics [ 45 ] . Case-specific neural fields [ 46 , 47 , 48 ] and anatomy-conditioned motion modes [ 49 ] make the representation responsive to individual observations. The shared family provides a reusable constraint across cases; conditioning or case-wise fitting determines which combinations of this structure are available for each observed anatomy. For unsupervised interpolation, the challenge is to learn a shared motion manifold from endpoint-derived evidence while retaining the motion needed by each pair.
blocks.zh: 通过坐标来描述它们的协调变化 来限制候选领域 统计呼吸系统模型[14]和所学变形表示[39,40] 提取了反复出现的结构;多重正规化指导了对一个已学家庭的估计领域[41]。 相关的心脏表达法编码为形状和时间变异[42,43,44],有条件的神经领域与个别特征相关的几何学[45]. 案例特定的神经领域[46,47,48]和解剖条件的运动模式[49]使得代表对个别观察的反应. 共有的家族在个案中提供了可重复使用的制约;根据条件或个案的适合性决定了每个观察到的解剖学中可使用哪种结构的组合。 对于无监督的内插,挑战在于从端点衍生的证据中学习一个共享运动倍数,同时保留每一对所需运动.

blocks.en: IV-B Quantitative Comparison
blocks.zh: 四-B 定量比较

blocks.en: Table I contrasts methods with different sources of motion guidance. Cyclic reconstruction in UVI-Net [ 6 ] and instance-specific refinement in TTT4MII [ 25 ] substantially improve ACDC reconstruction over VM, TM, and Fourier-Net+. Their less uniform gains on 4D-Lung, particularly across NMI and SSIM, underline the difficulty of inferring intervening anatomy from endpoint supervision alone. Our method maintains strong performance across all three criteria on both datasets. Cardiac contraction and respiratory deformation produce different patterns of image change; consistent results in both settings support a data-derived motion constraint across these distinct anatomical dynamics. Agreement across intensity, statistical dependence, and structural similarity measures also provides complementary evidence of reconstruction fidelity.
blocks.zh: 表一将方法与不同的运动导源对比. UVI-Net的循环重建[6]和TT4MII[25]中针对具体实例的改进大大改善了ACDC的重建,超过了VM、TM和Fourier-Net+。 它们在4D-Lung上,特别是在NMI和SSIM上获得的不太统一的收益,凸显了仅从端点监督中推断出干预解剖的难度. 我们的方法在两个数据集的所有三个标准上都保持了强大的性能。 心肌收缩和呼吸系统变形产生不同的图像变化规律;两种环境的一致结果都支持了数据衍生的运动制约,跨越这些明显的解剖动力学. 强度、统计依赖性和结构相似性衡量方法之间的一致,也为重建忠心提供了补充证据。

blocks.en: Intermediate-supervised methods provide a complementary comparison. Multi-scale deformation fusion in MPVF and TMSDF [ 20 , 24 ] , multiple motion fields in AMT [ 21 ] , and distance-indexed guidance in VD [ 8 ] enrich the motion information used for synthesis. Their strengths differ across criteria: on 4D-Lung, MPVF achieves high PSNR and AMT high NMI, while their SSIM is less competitive. Intermediate supervision enriches the training cues, but reconstruction still depends on how these cues organize the estimated motion. Our method exceeds most of these approaches and remains close to the strongest results. Its near-leading respiratory PSNR is accompanied by strong NMI and SSIM, showing that similar overall intensity error can coexist with different levels of structural agreement. Achieving this balance without intermediate training targets supports the shared motion constraint as useful interpolation guidance.
blocks.zh: 中级监督方法提供了补充性比较。 MPVF和TMSDF[20,24]中的多尺度变形聚变,AMT[21]中的多运动场,以及VD[8]中的远程索引引导,丰富了用于合成的运动信息. 其优势因标准不同而不同:在4D-Lung上,MPVF实现高PSNR和AMT的NMI,而其SSIM的竞争力较低. 中间监管丰富了培训提示,但重建仍然取决于这些提示如何组织估计的运动. 我们的方法超过了大多数这些方法,仍然接近于取得最强的结果。 其近铅的呼吸道PSNR伴有强NMI和SSIM,表明类似的整体强度误差可以与不同层次的结构协议共存. 在没有中间培训目标的情况下实现这一平衡有助于将共同的运动限制作为有用的插值指导。

blocks.en: IV-C Qualitative Comparison
blocks.zh: 四-C 定性比较

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 4 , the methods recover broadly similar anatomy, but differ in how local boundaries and fine structures are reconstructed. In ACDC, our result retains the indentations along the ventricular blood-pool boundary and the separation of internal low-signal structures, which become smoother or less distinct in several predictions. On 4D-Lung, our reconstruction preserves narrow intrapulmonary profiles close to the reference. These differences reflect the spatial arrangement of local structures as well as their sharpness. A plausible-looking boundary may still have the wrong extent, while averaging misaligned structures can broaden or merge a narrow profile. The enlarged regions show that the learned motion family preserves this localized variation alongside the overall anatomical change.
blocks.zh: 如图4所示,这些方法恢复了大致相似的解剖学,但当地边界和精细结构的重建方式有所不同. 在发改委中,我们的结果保留了排气血池边界上的凹陷和内部低信号结构的分离,这些结构在几个预测中变得比较平滑或不太明显. 4D -Lung上,我们的重建保存了接近参考文献的狭义肺内侧图. 这些差异反映了地方结构的空间安排及其锐度。 貌似合理的边界可能仍然有错误的范围,而平均的错位结构可以扩大或合并狭义的轮廓。 扩大的地区表明,在整体解剖变化的同时,学识丰富的运动家族保留了这种局部变化。

blocks.en: IV-E Analysis of Sample-Conditioned Reorientation
blocks.zh: 四-E 对抽样条件调整的分析

blocks.en: Reorientation across intrinsic dimensions. Fixed uses the unrotated embedding c = E ​ z c=Ez , while Active uses c = Q ⁡ ( z ) ​ E ​ z c=Q(z)Ez , with other settings held fixed. Active improves reconstruction throughout the tested range of d d in Fig. 6 (a), and its performance levels off near d = 40 d=40 . A smaller Active coordinate set can also match or exceed larger Fixed configurations. The advantage reflects how effectively the shared directions are used as well as the number of independent motion variables. The fixed embedding gives every pair the same motion directions, even though the anatomy and motion state differ. Sample-conditioned reorientation preserves useful individual variation within a restricted coordinate budget, reducing the need to recover expression solely by enlarging that budget.

blocks.en: Global versus sample-conditioned reorientation. Global learns one orientation shared by all cases, whereas Sample predicts the orientation from each pair’s motion coordinates; other settings are held fixed. Cases are ranked by mean absolute foreground intensity change between sampled reference volumes and divided into low, medium, and high thirds. In Fig. 6 (b), Sample yields larger gains at matched generator strengths α \alpha , with both variants returning to the unrotated embedding at α = 0 \alpha=0 . The consistent advantage favors adapting the shared directions to each endpoint pair. Even the low-change group benefits, indicating that sample dependence is useful beyond cases with large image changes. Moderate generator strengths give the largest gains, balancing directional flexibility with controlled departures from the unrotated shared reference.
blocks.zh: 全球与抽样调整。 Global学习了所有案例共享的一个方向,而样本则预测从每对对运动坐标得到的方向;其他设置被固定。 案例按抽样参考卷之间的平均绝对前景强度变化排列,分为低、中和高三部分。 在图6(b)中,样本在相匹配的生成力α-α时产生较大的增益,两种变体都回到α=0-α=0时的未旋转嵌入. 一致的优势有利于将共享方向调整到每个端点对. 即使是低变化组的效益,也表明样本依赖性在图像发生较大变化的情况之外是有用的. 中度生成器的优点带来最大的收益,在方向灵活性与可控偏离未旋转的共享参考值之间取得平衡。

blocks.en: Alternative reorientation mappings. We compare Cayley with matrix-exponential and QR-based orthogonal mappings, and with an MLP that directly predicts length-normalized coordinates. To remove between-case difficulty offsets, each PSNR is centered by subtracting that case’s mean across the four mappings. The distributions in Fig. 6 (c) place Cayley close to the other orthogonal constructions and above the normalized MLP. The MLP’s lower scores favor structured directional mappings over directly predicting a length-matched coordinate vector. The comparable performance of the orthogonal variants supports structured directional adaptation as the central benefit of reorientation. Cayley provides a competitive realization of this flexibility with norm preservation and a low-rank-controlled departure from the shared directions.
blocks.zh: 备选调整方向制图. 我们比较Cayley和基于矩阵的和基于QR的正交映射,以及直接预测长度常态坐标的MLP. 为了消除两案之间的困难,每个PSNR都以在四个绘图中减去该案件的平均值为中心。 图6(c)中的分布使凯利靠近其他正交结构,并高于正规的MLP. MLP的低分数偏好结构化的方向映射, 正交变体的可比较性能支持结构化的方向适应,作为调整方向的中心利益. Cayley通过规范保存和低级控制偏离共同方向,为这种灵活性提供了竞争性的实现.

blocks.en: Temporal reconstruction fidelity. As shown in Fig. 7 (a), our reconstructions follow the evolving ventricular contours and blood-pool appearance, while local boundaries and internal contrast are less faithfully recovered by LDDM and Fourier-Net+. This comparison tests whether detail preserved at one query also changes appropriately at other times, including the relative positions of local boundaries as the ventricle deforms. A shared velocity representation links these reconstructions, allowing the observed anatomy to evolve coherently across intermediate queries.
blocks.zh: 时间重建忠贞。 如图7(a)所示,我们的重建遵循不断演变的通风轮廓和血库外观,而地方边界和内部对比则不太被LDDM和Fourier-Net+忠实地恢复。 这种比较检验在一次查询中是否保留细节,在其他时间也会适当变化,包括作为通风孔变形的局部边界的相对位置. 共同的速度表示将这些重建联系起来,使所观测到的解剖学在中间询问之间有一致的发展。

blocks.en: Relative change error measures the mean absolute discrepancy between predicted and reference adjacent-volume change rates, normalized by each case’s time-averaged absolute reference-change rate. Rates use the actual time separation between volumes, with spatial averaging over anatomy identified by intensity variation in the reference sequence. Our method closely tracks MPVF and remains below LDDM and Fourier-Net+ across the intervals in Fig. 7 (b), and below DDM in four of five intervals. These results complement frame-wise similarity: the preserved ventricular detail is accompanied by competitive agreement with reference change rates across the sampled intervals, linking anatomical appearance to the progression of image change over time.
blocks.zh: 相对变化误差衡量了预测的和参考的相邻量变化率之间的平均绝对差数,按每个案例的时间平均绝对参考率计算。 速率采用量与量之间的实际时间分离,通过参考序列的强度变化确定解剖学的空间平均值. 我们的方法密切跟踪MPVF,在图7(b)的间隔处一直保持在LDDM和Fourier-Net+以下,在DDM下则每隔五分之四。 这些结果补充了帧式的相似性:保存下来的通风细节伴随着竞争性协议,在整个抽样间隔期间的参考变化率,将解剖外观与图像随时间推移而变化联系起来。

blocks.en: Segmentation consistency. A standard 3D U-Net [ 57 ] trained on ACDC training cases is frozen and applied to both reconstructed and reference volumes; Dice measures agreement between its predicted masks. Our method approaches MPVF and exceeds Fourier-Net+ and DDM across the three structures in Fig. 8 (a). Its advantage over LDDM in MYO and LV indicates that maintaining blood-pool appearance alone does not ensure consistent myocardial extent. Cavity and myocardial masks depend on neighboring boundaries, so a local contour shift can alter their relative extent even when the overall appearance changes little. Agreement across these regions supports preservation of their relative configuration during interpolation. The overlays in Fig. 8 (b) connect reconstruction fidelity with consistent structural delineation.

blocks.en: Computational cost. Our method provides higher query throughput than MPVF, DDM, and LDDM, with estimated training time close to DDM, as shown in Table IV . Training uses the dense head to build motion evidence; query-time synthesis uses the shared reference and predicted motion coordinates without this auxiliary head. Fourier-Net+ is faster, but the reconstruction comparisons favor our method. The resulting trade-off places the framework between fast band-limited synthesis and more expensive motion-guided or generative alternatives, retaining sample-specific motion expression at a moderate synthesis cost and making that flexibility practical for repeated queries in temporally dense reconstruction.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: We presented a framework that learns a motion manifold to constrain ambiguity in unsupervised 4D medical image interpolation. Cross-sample spectral basis learning captures recurring motion structure from endpoint-derived estimates, while sample-conditioned Cayley reorientation varies the effective motion directions without increasing the number of independent motion coordinates. The resulting representation accommodates sample-specific variation within a restricted motion family. Experiments on ACDC and 4D-Lung demonstrate state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated methods trained without intermediate volumes and competitive results against methods using intermediate supervision. Module analyses, temporal evaluation, and motion-estimation consistency link these reconstruction results to effective use of the shared directions and reproducible motion estimates. Learning a shared motion family while adapting its expression to individual observations provides a useful representation-level constraint on ambiguity in endpoint-supervised interpolation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个框架, 学习一个运动的多面性 限制模糊不清 在不受监督的4D 医疗图像插图。 跨样本光谱基础学习从端点产生的估计中捕捉经常性运动结构,而样本条件的凯利重定向则在不增加独立运动坐标的情况下改变有效的运动方向. 由此产生的表述可容纳受限制运动家族中的特定样本差异。 有关非加太催化中心和4D-Lung的实验显示,在没有中间卷量和与使用中间监督的方法相比有竞争结果的经过培训的方法中,表现最先进。 模块分析、时间评估和运动估计的一致性将这些重建成果与有效使用共同方向和可复制的运动估计联系起来。 学习一个共同的运动家族,同时将其表达方式适应个人观察,对端点监督的插图中含糊不清提供了有益的代表层次限制。
